summary: Standalone diagnostic stops its owned observer on every exit; all admission uses observer duration and optional trial deadline, including startup device query; baseline, device query, samples and final observation consume a single lifetime call allowance. Shared byte admission includes actual process and device bytes and conservative reservations; expired/exhausted final probes remain unavailable. No runner or CLI edits.
API: No signature changes. Collector bytes_read is actual process-status bytes; device_query_bytes_read is actual device-pipe bytes, with non-overlapping sum limited by MAX_COLLECTOR_BYTES. Sample reserves full read cap and device query reserves both pipe caps plus two lookahead bytes. Each baseline, device query, sample, or combined final CPU/lifetime observation counts once. Sample completion wakes standalone wait, allowing an admitted final measurement before expiry. Refused final measurement returns null CPU delta/lifetime RSS. Device cleanup waits at most 0.5 seconds each for terminate and kill.
